about_the_game:
This is a horror game that requires you to constantly avoid the pursuit of evil spirits.

How to play:

You, who have been eroded by the cursed disc, must actively fall into the scene it records. Before the data evil spirit tears you apart, touch the energy stone to light up the purification array. Under Annie's gaze, complete this video recording to please the existence of evil!

Game features:

Evil spirit: It will continue to chase you, and the farther away from you, the faster it will be.

Outsmart: The speed of the evil spirit is always faster than you. Please make good use of its inability to jump: Even if it is getting closer and closer to you now, it may take the initiative to move away from you in the next second.

Environment: As the progress increases, the attention of evil beings is gradually attracted to you, heavy rain falls from the sky, and the environment becomes increasingly harsh.

Annie: She carelessly released this evil spirit and reaped the consequences. Now she is wandering in the cracks of time and space. She must help you complete the purification to achieve redemption.

Control method:

WSAD controls forward, backward, left, and right movement, the mouse rotates the view, and esc pauses.

Thank：

This game is the first game made by me alone, and I look forward to any feedback from you!
